Pursuant to the provisions of Regulation 30 of the Listing Regulations, this is to inform you that a conference call for analysts/institutional investors will be held on Tuesday, September 1, 2026, at 10:30 a.m. (IST) in respect of the un-audited financial results (Standalone and Consolidated) of the Company for the quarter ended June 2026, as per the details attached herewith.

Please note that no Unpublished Price Sensitive Information (UPSI) is proposed to be shared by the Company during the aforesaid investor meeting.

Pursuant to Regulation 33 and 30 read with Schedule III of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 ('SEBI Listing Regulations'), we hereby inform you that the Board of Directors of the Company, at its meeting held today, i.e., August 13, 2026, inter-alia, considered and approved the Unaudited Financial Results (standalone and consolidated) of the Company for the quarter ended June 30, 2026. The Financial Results and Statutory Auditor's Limited Review Reports thereon are enclosed.
Press Release - Un-audited Financial Results for the quarter ended on June 30, 2026.
Modification of the vesting schedule and Ratification of the ESOP Scheme
Investor Presentation for the Earnings Conference call with Analysts and Investors
Newspaper advertisement pertaining to the unaudited financial results of the Company for the quarter ended June 30, 2026.
Audio recording link of the Q1 FY 2027 Earnings Conference Call
Intimation of Schedule of Analyst/Investor Meeting
